description: The agent systems Actor routes to, with what each can do, its trust class, its rate card and whether it is available now (GET /api/v1/agents, actor.agent-list-result@1), and which one a task would go to in a mode, with the reason for every candidate (POST /api/v1/route { task, mode }, a platform.placement-result@1; nothing runs). Public; no token needed.
